name: TabBar
summary: The bottom bar of three to five top level destinations on phone layouts: an icon over a label for each, the current one marked.
useWhen: Three to five top level destinations of an app on a phone width layout
Destinations a person moves between often and wants one thumb tap away
A web app that replaces its Sidebar or Rail with a bottom bar under breakpoint.tablet
avoidWhen: Switching panels of content inside one page
More than five destinations, or only two
Actions such as Add or Share

insteadUse.More than five destinations: Sidebar in a Drawer, or a More destination page

aria-label.description: TabBar: required unless aria-labelledby is set. Names the landmark: Main.

size.description: TabBar: md items are at least size.control.md (32px) with 16px icons; lg items are at least 44px (size.control.lg, never under size.touch-ios) with 24px icons, for touch layouts.

label.description: TabBarItem: the visible name, a short noun. Always shown; a long one ends in an ellipsis and stays whole in the link name.

icon.description: TabBarItem: a system icon name. Decorative.

active.description: TabBarItem: the current destination. Sets aria-current page and data-active: a bolder label and a pill behind the icon.

badge.description: TabBarItem: a count (99+ past 99, Western digits) or true for a dot. 0 and false show nothing. Its words join the link name.

badgeLabel.description: TabBarItem: the words the badge adds to the name: Inbox, 3 new. A dot says New. Arabic: جديد.

asChild.description: TabBarItem: renders its one child element (a router link) as the item.

a11y.role: navigation (the nav landmark) with a name; each item is a link, the current one with aria-current page.
a11y.focus: Every item is a tab stop, in reading order.
a11y.announce: Each link reads its label, its badge words (Inbox, 3 new) and current page for the active one.
notes: The current item is marked by aria-current, a bolder label and a pill behind its icon, never by color alone (WCAG 1.4.1).
Labels are always visible; icons are decorative.
The bar pads its block end by env(safe-area-inset-bottom) and its sides by the side insets.
A bar fixed to the bottom of the viewport covers content unless the page keeps the same room at its end (WCAG 2.4.11): the layout (PageShell) reserves it.
lg gives 44px targets for touch layouts (WCAG 2.5.8 and the touch template rule); md items are at least 32px.
No native title attribute; a cut label keeps its full text in the link name.
env(safe-area-inset-*) is 0 unless the page sets viewport-fit=cover in its viewport meta tag.

en.label: One short noun, sentence case: Home, Search, Inbox. No verbs.
en.landmark: Name it after the app section, never the same name as another nav on the page.

ar.label: Noun form labels, white Saudi dialect, no diacritics: الرئيسية، البحث، الوارد.
ar.badge: Western digits; the badge words read جديد.

react.note: No motion of its own: the current item's colors swap at once. fade-rise is the pattern a layout uses if it reveals the bar. Round 2 (order 1.22, proposed), interaction tab-bar-pop: when an item becomes current its icon and pill pop from scale.anticipate past rest and its label rises a stagger step later (CSS keyframes that start with data-active). Reduced motion: nothing moves.

native.behavior: react-navigation bottom tabs or a hand built bar
native.note: 44pt on iOS, 48dp on Android; safe area from react-native-safe-area-context.

styles.studio: A surface-2 bar with a subtle top hairline, muted labels, the current item bright and bold with an overlay-20 pill behind its icon.
styles.desk: The same parts on Desk tokens: the Desk surface and type.
styles.neutral: Token driven; applies once the Neutral pack is merged.

mistakes.right: A short visible label on every item

mistakes.wrong: Six or seven destinations squeezed into the bar
mistakes.right: Five at most; the rest go on a More page or in a Drawer

mistakes.wrong: A TabBar that switches panels inside a page
The current item shown only by color
mistakes.right: active: aria-current, weight and the icon pill

mistakes.wrong: A fixed bar over the last line of the page
mistakes.right: Reserve the bar's height at the end of the page

mistakes.wrong: A bottom bar on a phone page without viewport-fit=cover
mistakes.right: Set viewport-fit=cover so the safe area padding applies
